profileOverview.title: View Approved Profile
profileOverview.subtitle: Only the approved profile is used for matching, and changes under review remain isolated until approved.
profileOverview.actions.title: Keep your profile progressing
profileOverview.actions.subtitle: Go to the profile wizard to view all fields or edit what reviewers have requested.
profileOverview.actions.restriction: You can edit fields but cannot delete current qualifications, experiences, courses, or achievements, and the date of birth remains locked.
profileOverview.pendingWarning: Pending edits do not affect nominations until they are approved.
profileOverview.activeSnapshot: The current approved version is the one used for matching.

profileOverview.statusCard.heading: Track your profile status
profileOverview.requests.title: Edit Requests
profileOverview.requests.heading: Submit and track edits
profileOverview.requests.pendingBody: Your approved data will remain active while the proposed edits are under review.
profileOverview.requests.cleanBody: There are no pending change requests, and you can start submitting a new edit when needed.
profileOverview.pendingHint: You can track what has been submitted without affecting your approved profile.
profileOverview.profileStatusDescription: Complete your profile data to submit it for review.
Profile has been submitted and is awaiting initial review.
Your data is being verified and you will be notified of any notes.
Updates have been requested. Please edit and resubmit.
Your profile has been approved and is used for matching while new edits are reviewed independently.
The submission was rejected. Review the notes and then resubmit a corrected request.
The profile has been cancelled. You can submit a new request to reactivate.
The profile has been cancelled by administration. Contact support for more details.
profileOverview.statusDescriptions.notRe: Your profile has not yet been submitted or still needs to complete the required data.
profileOverview.statusDescriptions.pendi: Edit requests are being reviewed while keeping the current approved version active.
profileOverview.statusDescriptions.appro: The latest version of your profile has been approved and can be used for nominations.
profileOverview.statusDescriptions.rejec: The edit or some data has been rejected; you can review the notes and resubmit.
profileOverview.statusDescriptions.needs: There are notes that need correction before the edit can be approved.
profileOverview.actionCenter.title: Action Center
profileOverview.actionCenter.heading: Comply with reviewer notes
profileOverview.actionCenter.body: Follow the reviewer notes, edit the highlighted fields, then resubmit from the same page.
profileOverview.howItWorks.title: How Do Updates Work?
profileOverview.howItWorks.subtitle: Learn about your request's journey from draft to approval.
profileOverview.howItWorks.stepDraft: Complete or edit your information and save the changes.
profileOverview.howItWorks.stepSubmit: Submit the edits to open a new review version.
profileOverview.howItWorks.stepReview: Track pending requests while the approved version remains active.
profileOverview.howItWorks.stepRespond: Respond to reviewer notes, resubmit, and track the status.
profileOverview.timeline.title: Review Timeline
profileOverview.timeline.subtitle: Dates help you track submissions and reviewer responses.
profileOverview.timeline.tipBody: Open the profile section, edit the highlighted fields here, then resubmit so the reviewer can close the request.

profileView.statusHint.rejected: Your profile was rejected. Address the correction notes; approved items remain read-only.
